name: Strength of Night — kicked gives Zombies an additional +2/+2
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py ('if kicked' theme). 'Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, Zombie creatures you control get an additional +2/+2 until end of turn.' No 'instead', so the first sentence always applies; the kicked sentence has its own subject and 'an additional' is dropped. Kicked: Walking Corpse (Zombie 2/2) is 5/5, Grizzly Bears 3/3.
